map.以「新车价 20 万、车龄 4 年、累计里程 8 万公里」为例: Taking 'new price 200,000 CNY, age 4 years, cumulative mileage 80,000 km' as an example

map.二手车保值率/残值计算: Used-Car Value Retention / Residual Value Calculation
map.成新率为什么取车龄和里程的较小值？: Why does the new-car rate take the smaller of age and mileage?
map.车辆残值受「车龄折旧」与「里程折旧」双重约束，任一维度恶化都会拉低价值，因此取两: Residual value is constrained by both age depreciation and mileage depreciation; deterioration in either dimension lowers value, so take the smaller (with a 0.45 floor to avoid zero) as the overall new-car rate. Mileage is in 10,000 km.
map.估值和实际成交价差很多？: Why does the estimate differ a lot from the actual transaction price?
map.本工具是线性简化折旧模型，未计入品牌保值率、车况、地区行情、配置与事故历史。实际: This tool is a linear simplified depreciation model and does not account for brand value retention, condition, regional market, trim or accident history. Actual transactions should follow same-model market prices and professional inspection; this valuation is only a quick baseline.
